name: WatchSync
overview: Sync watch history between copies of the same media (e.g. 4K and HD libraries)
description:
Keeps the watched state, resume position, play count and last played date in sync between copies of the same movie or episode stored in different libraries (for example a 1080p and a 4K library), in both directions.

Copies are matched by identity, never by file path: TMDB or IMDb for movies; the series TVDB or IMDb id plus season and episode numbers for episodes. A scheduled task realigns all copies after the fact, e.g. after files were moved.

versions.changelog:
- Fix the other copy's item page still showing "not watched" after a sync,
  until Jellyfin was restarted (the library view was already correct).

- Jellyfin 12.x support (built for 12.4, .NET 10).
- Fix the full sync task crashing on recent Jellyfin versions.
- Much faster: copies are looked up by provider id instead of scanning the library.
- Stricter matching: one shared id and no conflicting id; movies and episodes never mix.
- Un-marking an item now resets the other copies too.
- The full sync merges history without losing it, and only writes what changed.
- External tools writing user data (e.g. CrossWatch) are synced live.
- Removed settings: completion threshold and provider priority.
Initial release with automatic sync and scheduled task

name: JellyTag
overview: Overlays quality badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language) on media posters and thumbnails
description:
JellyTag automatically overlays quality badges on your media posters and thumbnails: resolution, HDR and Dolby Vision, video codec, audio, language flags and VOST indicator. Badges are rendered server-side and visible on all Jellyfin clients.

Per-panel configuration, SVG and text badge styles, custom badge upload, live preview and library filtering.

versions.changelog:
- Save no longer fails silently: an invalid setting turns red while typing, and
  Save opens its section and points to it.
- Clearer settings: units in the size, margin and gap labels, shorter
  descriptions, gap up to 100%.
- "Join the previous panel's row" is grayed out when it has no effect.

- Optional rating badges: TMDB/IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings stored by
  Jellyfin, with a star and a tomato icon (replaceable).
- Top center and bottom center positions; a panel can join the previous panel's
  row; badge sizes up to 100%.
- Switch to leave episode images without badges.
- Fixes: a zero margin is kept, sizes above 50% are honoured, simpler video
  length panel.

- Subtitles get their own panel: position, layout, colors, all languages or only
  those without matching audio, labels as EN, CC EN or VOSTEN. Existing setups
  keep their VOST look.
- Language filters: show only some languages, or all except some; undefined (und)
  tracks are hidden.
- Optional Dolby Vision profile badge (DV P5, P7, P8.1...).
- Reworked configuration page: compact panels, each customizing only its active
  badges; languages are picked by name.

- Badges cover every version of a movie (e.g. 1080p and 4K files).
- Language flags: the default audio track comes first, the others alphabetically;
  15 new flags; flags can be replaced in the custom badge gallery.
- Dolby Vision is shown with its HDR10/HDR10+/HLG base layer, Atmos with
  TrueHD, DTS:X with DTS-HD MA (set the HDR or audio panel to "All" to see both).
- French VFQ/VFF audio detection and an optional video length badge.
- Intro videos added by other plugins no longer get badges.

- Jellyfin 12.x support (built for 12.4, .NET 10).
- Fix 401 errors on configuration export and broken custom badge previews.
- Plugin data no longer lives in Jellyfin's plugins folder, which could wipe
  every plugin's settings on servers whose path contains an underscore (e.g. QNAP).
- Narrow 1080p encodes (e.g. 4:3 at 1440x1080) and 4:3 720p are detected correctly.
- Uses Jellyfin's own Svg.Skia: the package now ships a single DLL.
Fix: exclude SkiaSharp native assets that caused plugin loading crash, pin Jellyfin packages to 10.11.0 for full 10.11.x compatibility
Fix: support Jellyfin base URL configuration, fix resolution detection thresholds
v2: Multi-category badges (resolution, HDR, codec, audio, language, VOST), per-panel config, SVG rendering with SkiaSharp, custom badge upload, live preview, library filtering, config export/import
Initial release with quality detection, configurable badges, and image caching
